evals.prompt: Follow the BDK swarm skill to run wave 1 of the active Change. The plan has four tasks: 01-1 (Files: `src/a`, `src/b`), 01-2 (Files: `src/c`), 01-3 (Files: `src/b`, `src/d`) and 01-4 (Files: `src/e`). `execution.concurrency` is 2. Say which tasks you dispatch in which wave, and how many agents run at once.
evals.expected_output: 01-1, 01-2 and 01-4 share no file and can go in the first wave, but at most two agents run at once, so the third waits for a free slot; 01-3 shares `src/b` with 01-1 and waits for the next wave. Each agent gets only its package path from `bdk dispatch build`.

assertions.name: overlapping_task_waits
assertions.description: Holds back the task whose Files overlap another task of the wave (01-3 overlaps 01-1 on src/b) for the next wave

assertions.name: respects_concurrency
assertions.description: Never has more than two agents running at once, taking the number from the Concurrency section of the BDK context

assertions.name: package_path_prompt
assertions.description: Each agent prompt is the package path from bdk dispatch build plus at most one sentence, with no task text pasted in

assertions.name: reads_ledger_between_waves
assertions.description: Before the next wave, reads what the finished tickets logged with bdk log list --since-ticket-start <ticket>

evals.prompt: Following the BDK swarm skill, the implementer agent of ticket A-7f3k9m2q returned an envelope with status done, but no report exists at the report path its package names. What do you do, and what do you do if the resumed agent again returns without a stored report?
evals.expected_output: Resume the same agent once, naming the missing report at the package's report path. If the report is still missing after the resume, close the ticket fail with bdk attempt close A-7f3k9m2q fail and the reason; no second resume, and no step package is built for the ticket before the resume is over.

assertions.name: resumes_once_naming_problem
assertions.description: Resumes the same agent exactly once and names the missing report in the resume message

assertions.name: closes_fail_after_second_failure
assertions.description: After the second failure closes the ticket with bdk attempt close <ticket> fail and a reason, without a further resume

assertions.name: no_next_package_during_resume
assertions.description: Does not build the simplifier or runner package of the ticket while the implementer's resume is pending

assertions.name: does_not_write_report
assertions.description: Does not write the report file itself or ask another agent to write it

evals.prompt: Following the BDK swarm skill, three implementer agents of one wave are running. One of them sends you a SendMessage to main: 'critical: the schema migration drops user data, see finding L-4m8rt2wx'. Two more packages of the wave are still waiting for a free slot. What do you do next?
evals.expected_output: Stop the wave: start no new agent, let the running agents finish, read entry L-4m8rt2wx from the ledger, and decide on it before any further dispatch.

assertions.name: starts_no_new_agent
assertions.description: Does not dispatch the two waiting packages after the critical message

assertions.name: lets_running_agents_finish
assertions.description: Does not kill or abandon the agents already running

assertions.name: reads_named_entry
assertions.description: Reads the entry the message names (L-4m8rt2wx) through the ledger before deciding
